sources.note: Main product page. Describes QSmartCare as cloud-based wound care EHR developed over 30 years by Dr. Steven Magilen. Lists key features: accelerated charting, CDS, care plans, API integration, multi-device access.

ONC costs/disclosure page. Lists standard and additional costs (setup, subscription, third-party fees). References NewCrop (e-prescribing), Data Motion (Direct messaging), Google Authentication as third-party dependencies.

Quality Surgical Management (parent company) website. QSM is the wound care services company that built and uses QSmartCare. Founded 1999 by Dr. Magilen. 605 facilities served, 171,129 patients treated, 25 years of operations. Provides bedside wound care in SNFs across 6 states.

Real-world testing results for 2023. Critically reveals that QSmartCare is only used by one provider (QSM itself). Most certified features (Direct messaging, eCQM, immunizations) had zero real-world usage. Testing was done with test patients for compliance.

API documentation page. Shows FHIR R4 API (US Core 3.1) supporting 21 resources, plus legacy Patient API returning C-CDA XML. Resources include Patient, Condition, AllergyIntolerance, CarePlan, CareTeam, MedicationRequest, Encounter, Observation, Procedure, Device, DiagnosticReport, DocumentReference, Goal, Immunization, and others.

iOS app listing. Free app by Quality Surgical Management. Features: view schedules, access patient details, capture wound photographs with auto edge detection, offline login. No user reviews available. 81.8 MB, iOS 14.0+.

MatrixCare partner page describing bidirectional integration: patient face sheet data flows into QSmartCare, wound documentation flows back to MatrixCare. Key interoperability workflow for SNF wound care.

EHI export documentation page (Phase 2 target). High-level: offers PDF and JSON export formats, single and bulk patient export, accessed via Patient > CCDA > Export menu, requires Author-level permissions.
ZoomInfo company profile (access blocked). Search results indicated ~75 employees, 2 continents (North America, Asia), less than $5M raised in single 2020 funding round.
LinkedIn company page (referenced in search results). No additional detail beyond what was found elsewhere.
